items.quote: The chemical composition of each phase in the samples was determined using a field-emission electron probe microanalyzer (FE-EPMA, JXA-8530F Plus, JEOL, Japan). The composition of each phase was measured for at least 3 times with a deviation among the measurements less than 5%.
The crystal structure was characterized using an X-ray diffractometer (XRD, D2-Phaser, Bruker, USA) with the Cu-KS radiation at room temperature.

The microsturctures of the alloys were examined using a scanning electron microscope (SEM, SU3500, Hitachi, Japan) with a backscaterred electron (BSE) detector under the acceleration voltage of 20 kV.

records.quote: Therefore, we chose to investigate the Mo-Nb-Re alloy with a nominal composition within this tie-triangle, i.e., Mo-17.2 at.%Nb-51.6 at.%Re, equilibrated at the same temperature (1973K) for verification. However, as shown in the BSE micrograph and the XRD pattern (Figs. 3 (a) and (b), respectively), a two-phase equilibrium between the χ and bcc phases was found, which is contradictory to the data reported by Tsagaraeva et al. [28]. The average compositions of the χ and bcc phases were determined to be Mo-15.5 at.%Nb-63.9 at.%Re and Mo-19.3 at.%Nb-34.8 at.%Re, respectively, based on the FEEPMA analyses as tabulated in Table V.

records.quote: Figures 3 (c)-(d) and (e)-(f) show the BSE micrographs and XRD patterns of the Mo-17.2 at.%Nb-51.6 at.%Re alloy annealed at 2173 and 2373K, respectively. As expected, the one at the highest annealing temperature (2373K) showed the best crystallinity and the most coarsened grain structure. Nevertheless, Similar to that at 1973K, the χ + bcc two-phase equilibrium was observed at both 2173 and 2373K. As summarized in Table V, the average composition of the χ phase does not change much among the three temperature, ranging from Mo-15.5 at.%Nb-63.9 at.%Re to Mo13.9 at.%Nb-63.1 at.%Re. On the other hand, the contents of the bcc phase show a clear trend between 1973 and 2373K. The average composition of the bcc phase varies from Mo-19.3 at.%Nb34.8 at.%Re to Mo-18.8. at.%Nb-37.5 at.%Re and Mo-17.5 at.%Nb-39.2 at.%Re.
